hook.text: 4 hours of overthinking today. 4 minutes of dhikr?

captions: The bills. The future. What they think of you.
Your thoughts run faster than your feet.
And not once did you say His name.
Tonight, you sit by the sea. Phone away.
The same worries. A lighter heart.
Four minutes. And your heart can breathe.

verses.text: “Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.”

end.text: 4 hours of overthinking today. 4 minutes of dhikr?
end.gold: Tonight: 4 minutes of dhikr before you sleep.

post.caption:
4 hours of overthinking today. 4 minutes of dhikr? 🤍

“Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.” (13:28)

Tonight, before you sleep: SubhanAllah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar. Give your heart 4 minutes. 🤲
